blocks.value: The main method has two parts: the heading (public static void main(String[] args)) and the body (the statements between the braces).

- public: an access modifier. main must be public so the Java interpreter can call it from outside the class.
- static: means the method can be called without creating an object first.
- void: means main doesn't return any value.
- main: the method name; the JVM always looks for and runs this method first.
- String[] args: the type of argument that can be passed into main from outside the program.
